$comment: Stackra file contract: Purpose: the shape of a SERVICE member's runway.yaml. Boundary: shape only; what the service IS is stackra.config.ts, what it NEEDS is derived by gen into the manifest `infra`, and the root runway (runway/root.json) holds destinations and defaults. Runtime: node (editors and validators). Governing contract: ADR 0296 (runway v3: requires, no root facts), ADR 0168 (runway.yaml schema), ADR 0227 (allowed engines), ADR 0238 (logical databases and pool budgets), ADR 0266 (mail driver), ADR 0173 (secret names), ADR 0190 (health), ADR 0146 (config layers).
title: runway.yaml (service member)
description: What one service needs (ADR 0296 d1): the dedicated resources it `requires`, secret NAMES, health thresholds, and per environment its dev port, the sizes of what it needs and its config. The folder names the member. Placement, cpu, memory and instances are root topology facts. What it needs is derived by gen into the manifest `infra`; this file only sizes it. No secret value, no business value.

$schema.description: The schema reference `stackra validate` reads (`@stackra/runway/schema/service.json`). Editors use the `# yaml-language-server: $schema=` comment instead.

secrets.description: Every @Secret of src/config/*, by NAME; gen fails on a missing one. Values live in Infisical (ADR 0173).

health.description: Thresholds only; the path and checks are stackra.config.ts `health` (ADR 0190).

requireMigrations.description: Not ready until every migration has run.

timeoutSeconds.description: Time a readiness check may take.

eventLoopLagMs.description: Event loop lag above which the process counts as stuck.

environments.description: Per-environment values. Names are fixed (ADR 0170 DP5).

requires.description: Resource name → one resource the member needs beyond what gen derives from the manifest (ADR 0296 d1).

additionalProperties.description: One required resource. A dedicated one says why it cannot be shared.

engine.description: An engine ADR 0227 neither defers nor rejects (ADR 0296 d5); a dedicated search resource takes `postgres`.

dedicated.description: The member gets its own instance instead of the shared one.

reason.description: One line: why the member cannot share the resource.

port.description: A TCP port. Lanes add N × `portStep` per worktree.

queue.description: Size of one queue. Its name comes from the manifest.

visibilityTimeoutSeconds.description: How long a taken message stays hidden before it is retried.

dlq.description: Give the queue a dead-letter queue.

environment.description: One environment of a service member.

port.description: The service's own listener when run standalone; under `encore run` the root gateway fronts it.

devConsolePort.description: Port of the service's dev console.

database.description: Size of the service's logical database on the shared server (ADR 0238 d2).

poolBudget.description: Database connections this service may hold on the shared server; overrides root `defaults.service.database.poolBudget` (ADR 0238).

plan.description: Database plan; `shared` puts every preview on one small server.

extensions.description: Postgres extensions the service needs, from the approved list (ADR 0160).

readReplica.description: Give the service a read replica.

cache.description: Size of the service's cache: its keyspace on the shared cluster, or its own instance when `requires` makes it dedicated.

memoryMb.description: Memory of a dedicated cache in MB.

eviction.description: Eviction policy of a dedicated cache.

queues.description: Size per queue. Names come from the manifest (`@AsJob` / `@OnEvent` queues).

enabled.description: Run crons. `encore run` does not, so dev turns them off (ADR 0091).

secrets.description: The secret names this environment receives.

config.description: The last config layer (ADR 0146 CF3): per-environment @Env values and driver names, keyed by config key.
